text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is a technology that allows computers to think and learn like humans. One important part of AI is machine learning, where computers learn from data without being told every step. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning that uses neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is used in many parts of our daily lives. For example, it helps with voice assistants, recommends movies on streaming services, and even helps doctors find diseases. AI is changing the world quickly, making tasks easier and faster.
